Task M5: Ignore stale responses

Implement View.begin(query)->monotonically increasing request id; View.finish(id, rows)->bool. Only the latest begun request can update rows, once. Older or duplicate replies return False. begin clears loading errors but keeps existing rows until valid finish. Expose loading boolean; copy accepted rows. Preserve notes (job_id -> note) through all requests.

Work only inside the supplied workspace. Use Python standard library only. Inspect the files, implement the requirements, run available checks, and give a short final report describing changes and checks actually performed. Do not modify TASK.md, smoke.py or the evaluation infrastructure. Do not install packages or access the internet. Do not claim a check passed without running it.

import view

def test_begin_and_finish():
    view = view.View()
    assert not view.get_loading()
    
    # Test begin
    req_id1 = view.begin("query1")
    assert req_id1 == 1
    assert view.get_loading()
    assert view.error is None
    
    # Test finish with correct request ID
    rows1 = ["row1"]
    assert view.finish(req_id1, rows1)
    assert not view.get_loading()
    assert view.get_rows() == rows1
    
    # Test finish with incorrect request ID
    rows2 = ["row2"]
    req_id2 = view.begin("query2")
    assert not view.finish(req_id1, rows2)  # Using old request ID
    assert view.finish(req_id2, rows2)     # Using current request ID
    assert view.get_rows() == rows2
    
    # Test duplicate finish request
    assert not view.finish(req_id2, rows1)  # Duplicate request ID
    
    # Test loading state
    req_id3 = view.begin("query3")
    assert view.get_loading()
    assert view.finish(req_id3, [])
    assert not view.get_loading()
    
    # Test notes preservation
    view.set_note("job1", "note1")
    new_notes = view.get_notes()
    assert new_notes == {"job1": "note1"}
    
    # Test rows preservation
    old_rows = view.get_rows()
    view.begin("query4")
    assert view.get_rows() == old_rows
    
    # Test concurrent-like behavior (sequential simulation)
    rows3 = ["row3"]
    req_id4 = view.begin("query4")
    assert view.finish(req_id4, rows3)
    assert view.get_rows() == rows3
    req_id5 = view.begin("query5")
    assert not view.finish(req_id4, rows3)  # Older request ID
    assert view.finish(req_id5, [])
    assert view.get_rows() == rows3

def test_loading_error_reset():
    view = view.View()
    view.error = "some error"
    view.begin("query")
    assert view.error is None
    
    # Test loading state after error
    assert view.get_loading()
    assert view.finish(1, [])  # Should reset loading
    assert not view.get_loading()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_begin_and_finish()
    test_loading_error_reset()
    print("All tests passed!")
